result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: it creates a mutual cap equal to the greater of paid or payable 12-month fees and USD 1 million, mutually excludes indirect and consequential damages, includes all required uncapped carve-outs, and excludes Client fee-payment obligations from the cap. The changes are targeted and preserve the separate warranty disclaimer. Minor drafting imperfections include the undefined reference point for the “immediately preceding” 12-month period and slightly awkward phrasing in the Excluded Claims definition, but these do not materially prevent compliance.
